message:
test(safety): the guard keeps judging after the gate -- a later contradiction stops the run INVALID and ends its own children; fatal secures its ports and confirms every child's end (test-injection-finding r6, Codex ba2eaf2 G1 F)

- G1: e2e_injection_contradicted is the full state again (any power / input state line that is not the explicit
  OFF, before or after one that is -- a later power ON included) or input taken with injection on. A monitor per
  launched host (E2eInjectionMonitor) re-judges the launch's whole output every 200 ms after its initial gate, once
  more when the host is stopped, and once more before the test prints its result (e2e_injection_final_check_all); a
  contradiction -> its job ended (confirmed or said not), FAIL RUN ..., RESULT: INVALID, exit 2. Reported apart from
  the initial gate's PASS. Wired in all eight harnesses (standby_admission, punch_reply, migration, reboot_delegate:
  a monitor per host struct, stopped first in Stop(); android_session_reboot, bwe_observe, host_control_deadline,
  host_two_dispatcher: one after the gate, stopped before the job closes) and in fatal (each case's whole output
  judged at its end; run_with_client -> INVALID).
- F-a: e2e_child_util.hpp -- a loopback port with socket / bind / getsockname each checked, or 0; e2e_port_or_invalid
  ends the run INVALID before any child (a 0 would fall back to the product's 43000). fatal uses it for every port
  (run, run_with_client, the worker's seam).
- F-b: the --prelogin worker's timeout: its end confirmed through its own handle (a bounded wait that SAW it), else
  its log root and log are kept, cleanup deferred, said.
- F-c: every terminate in fatal and the shared adoption's recovery report what was confirmed -- never "ended" on
  the request alone (an unconfirmed end is a FAIL).
- e2e_guard_runtime_test (real call paths, no host: a fixed string and this executable sleeping in a kill-on-close
  job; each case in its own process): after the gate, power ON / another mode / injectionEnabled=1 later -> INVALID,
  child ended (confirmed); a quiet run not stopped; the pre-result check alone catches it too; port 0 (and socket()
  failing) -> INVALID before any child; a child's end confirmed when seen, a handle whose end cannot be seen -> "NOT
  confirmed". 10/10, x3.

Product sources untouched. All affected tests build; injection_guard 20/20, power_policy_record 27/27, record_match
9/9. Not run.
